name: sla_checker
description:
Deterministic UTC SLA evaluation as a single triage node. The model proposes
typed facts about one {rule, event} proposal; this workflow owns schema
validation, conflict detection, duplicate detection, SLO state and severity.
Port of code/qwen_vm/app_scenarios/sla_checker.
Folding boundaries (documented, not computed in the DSL):
- JSON parsing details (```json fence stripping, duplicate-key rejection,
"exactly {rule,event}" shape) fold into the single `proposal` choice.
- UTC business-window minute accumulation (add_business_minutes /
business_minutes_between: next-opening, day/window overlap, DST-free UTC
arithmetic) is deterministic clock arithmetic that does not belong in the
DSL; it is computed locally and surfaces here only as the SLO `sla` and
`severity` choices. The port judges the resulting state, never recomputes
a calendar.
- response_minutes > resolution_minutes and overlapping business windows are
both `rule` = conflict / overlap; `_MAX_SLO_MINUTES` / `_MAX_TIMELINE_DAYS`
bounds fold into the same schema bucket.
Emitted labels: reject_proposal, reject_rule, reject_rule_conflict,
reject_duplicate_rule, reject_event, reject_duplicate_event, breach_critical,
breach_high, breach_medium, breach_low, met, pending.

proposal.instructions: Does the proposal parse as exactly one object {rule, event} (UTF-8, no duplicate JSON keys, no fence/extra text)?

criteria.accepted: parses to exactly {rule, event}, no duplicate keys
criteria.malformed: parse error, duplicate JSON key, fence/extra text or wrong top shape

rule.instructions: Does the rule pass schema validation and registry admission (rule_id format, non-empty priorities with P1..P99 keys, response_minutes <= resolution_minutes, non-empty non-overlapping windows with start < end, id not already registered)?

criteria.ok: rule is schema-valid, conflict-free and new
criteria.bad_schema: malformed id / empty priorities / bad P-key / bad duration
criteria.overlap: overlapping windows, empty days, or start >= end
criteria.duplicate: rule_id already present in the registry

event.instructions: Does the event pass validation (all six keys present, UTC 'Z' timestamps only, responded_at >= created_at, resolved_at >= responded_at and >= created_at, priority key present in the rule, event_id not already evaluated)?

criteria.ok: event is schema-valid, time-consistent and new
criteria.bad_schema: missing/extra key or non-boolean-safe field shape
criteria.bad_time: non-UTC/DST offset, or timestamps out of order
criteria.unknown_priority: priority is not one of the rule's priority keys
criteria.duplicate: event_id was already evaluated in this ledger

sla.instructions: Overall SLO state (after local UTC business-window arithmetic; PENDING when the event has no respond/resolve yet).

criteria.pending: not yet responded and/or not yet resolved
criteria.breach: at least one deadline was missed

severity.instructions: Breach severity from the SLO overrun ratio (max of response/resolution ratios): NONE when no deadline is missed; CRITICAL when the priority is P1 or any overrun ratio >= 2.0; HIGH at >= 1.5; MEDIUM at >= 1.2; else LOW.
